Apprenticeship starts (Wales).label: Apprenticeship starts (Wales)
Apprenticeship starts (Wales).subtitle: Apprenticeship programme starts by people aged 16 or above, per 100,000 people
Apprenticeship starts (Wales).longDescription: This indicator shows apprenticeships started by adults aged 16+ based on home address, rate per 100,000 population, in Wales, for full academic years 2012/13 to 2024/25.

Apprenticeship achievements (Wales).label: Apprenticeship achievements (Wales)
Apprenticeship achievements (Wales).subtitle: Apprenticeship programme achievements by people aged 16 or above, per 100,000 people
Apprenticeship achievements (Wales).longDescription: This indicator shows apprenticeships achieved by adults aged 16+ based on home address, rate per 100,000 population, in Wales, for full academic years 2016/17 to 2024/25.
Apprenticeship achievements (Wales).caveats: The standard outcome measures were not produced in the 2019/20 and 2020/21 academic year due to the pandemic.
